Need Support with Your Drinking?

If you are concerned about your drinking habits or someone else's, help is available. Our support services can guide you through the steps to a healthier relationship with alcohol.

Find Support Services

Available Support Options:

  • Free confidential helpline: 0300 123 1110 (weekdays 9am–8pm, weekends 11am–4pm)
  • Online chat with trained advisors
  • Local support group directory
  • Self-help resources and guides

Our trained advisors are here to listen without judgment and can direct you to the most appropriate support for your situation.
